author: Suicasmo
coordinate_contract: All controls are original EXIF-oriented pixels. Stored uv=(oriented_y/5184,(3455-oriented_x)/3456). No resampled image is embedded.
method: Independent 3x4/perspective calibration provided the initial location; six visible glazing quadrilaterals were individually corrected against actual 100% inspection. Dark frame bars are detected only inside each registered window; every sampled glass pane is inset from them. Geometry frames remain independent untextured solids.
scope: Only six flat central third/fourth/fifth-floor glazing assemblies. Canted bays, attic, doors, stone, exterior shadows and occluded lower panes remain unprojected. The lower-left third-floor indoor dark reflection is inside real glazing, not a street object.
limitations: Manual outer glazing corners and per-pane registration are photographic estimates; not survey-grade photogrammetry.
Absolute front-plane u bias is not used to map glass.
No date claim beyond the referenced 2025 view.
